purpose: Generic receipt/route parity on multiple route shapes, proving the split is behavior-preserving across the FIP surface, not just the known cases.

generic_checks.shape: receipts serialized from several unseen route/decision shapes (not just the one used in fixtures)
generic_checks.assertion: existing fields normalized-JSON identical old vs new path

generic_checks.shape: FIP0 receipt with the full existing field set on an unseen input
generic_checks.assertion: byte-for-byte on deterministic fields; no field dropped/added/renamed (failure_classification is the only F1 additive)

generic_checks.shape: a decision producing multiple trace events on an unseen route
decisions spanning preview/advisory/write boundaries on unseen inputs
generic_checks.assertion: boundary classification identical old vs new

generic_checks.shape: each lane module invoked directly with an unseen input
generic_checks.assertion: produces same result as the equivalent decision.py path; no cross-lane hidden coupling

generic_checks.shape: static check for a second decision entrypoint

generation_rule: unseen route/decision shapes are generated by varying method, payload shape, and FIP combination without reusing fixture inputs; parity is the gate, not a memorized expected value
